what: A dotted stitch line is sewn out one stitch at a time. Each ‹ta-ta› grows one stitch (a 5px stitch + a 5px gap), alternating a short batch (15 stitches) and a long batch (40 stitches) to vary the rhythm all the way to the end of the line (normal: one stitch every 57ms). slow runs at 96ms with a .3~.6s rest between batches, notStop is fast at 42 · 28ms, and long is 100 · 32ms. A straight line (horizontal or vertical) or a single SVG curve placed inside is stitched with the same rhythm. It starts .2s after entering the area above the bottom 20% of the screen.

options.delay: Delay (ms) from entering (or loading) to start, default 200 — Brand hero’s two diagonals use 200 and 2900
options.on: load fires right away (after delay) without waiting to enter the screen. Default is once when it enters the screen
options.dir: Straight line direction x (horizontal) · y (vertical) — default is the box’s long side
options.[data-fx-part=path]: (If any) curve — <svg viewBox> Within <path>. Stitch and gap lengths are stretched to match screen px
